flows:
Navigate to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login then Log in with username tomsmith and password SuperSecretPassword! and assert the page shows You logged into a secure area!.
If anything blocks this flow, @v16:"stop and report what you saw".

remark: wait: queued plan (2 steps): type "Username"; type "Password"
click: Clicking Log in with username tomsmith
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the Secure Area page to load
analyze: The page shows You logged into a secure area!.
assert: the page shows You logged into a secure area!

summary:
Logged in to the secure area using the requested username and password.
The login page did not show anything that blocked the process.
The secure area displayed the message “You logged into a secure area!”.
